_comment: IWA Starknet MAINNET V2 (Candidate P private pot collection) deployment configuration. Copy to deploy-v2.config.json and fill deployer_account. Unlike the V1 config, NO addresses or class hashes live here: every security-critical value (USDC, STRK, pool, surplus_sink, setup_authority, both V2 class hashes) is hardcoded in iwa-deploy-v2.sh and re-asserted on chain. This file only names the signing account and, optionally, a fixed deployment salt.
_deployer_account: REQUIRED. The sncast account NAME (from `sncast account list`) that signs declare/deploy/invoke. Its resolved address MUST equal the hardcoded setup_authority (0x04099B8eBD6e6c642B4B31BFD27A9c781AB9b41D7f66F80d5C04CC51c0977E85); the script refuses otherwise. Must hold STRK for gas.
_salt: OPTIONAL. A fixed non-zero hex felt used for both deploys, for reproducibility. Omit to have the script generate and print a fresh random salt each run. Must NOT be 0x0.
